## What changes and why

Describe the user-visible behavior and link the issue. Use `Closes #123` only when this PR completes it.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their outcomes. For UI changes, include desktop/mobile screenshots when useful.

## Data considerations

If applicable: source/license, geography identifiers, periods, missing values, uncertainty, and interpretation limits. Do not include credentials, credential-bearing URLs or private data.

## Reviewer notes

Mention remaining limitations, migration/deployment needs, or focused questions. Delete sections that do not apply.
